description: Technology heat-rate ranges for Method B, kJ per kWh of net generation on a net calorific basis. Every range must cite its document, table and page and carry status CITED; build.py ignores anything else, so Method B stays BLOCKED until real, cited ranges are entered.
candidate_sources_to_read: Plant-specific heat rates or efficiencies, where BPDB or the operator publishes them
UNFCCC CDM Methodological Tool 07 (emission factor for an electricity system), its annex of default power-plant efficiencies: conservative single values, so they bound one side of a range only
US EIA Electric Power Annual, average operating heat rates by prime mover and energy source: US fleet, so wide bounds only
